title: Rewire WeWeb /new-project for speculative ingest
description: Backend is deployed but the new flow is inert until WeWeb changes. (1) Move the project + chat_session creation RPCs from Submit to page mount so both ids exist at drag-drop. (2) On file drop, after the existing S3/CDN upload, POST /speculative-ingest/ with {cdn_url,filename,file_size_bytes,project_id,user_id,chat_session_id} and collect the returned doc_id into a pendingDocIds variable. (3) On the file card x, POST /speculative-upload/cancel/. (4) On Submit, POST /new-rag-project/attach-note/ with pendingDocIds + note_type + note_title and navigate to /chat/{chat_session_id} on the 200 - remove the realtime wait on vector_embed_status COMPLETE that currently gates navigation. (5) In ww_socket.js handle the new message types ingest_progress, note_progress and waiting_for_documents, writing {stage,label,pct} to a new variable bound to the source card and note panel loaders. (6) Keep the document_sources and notes realtime subscriptions as the terminal-state fallback. (7) Bind the PDF viewer to document_sources.cdn_url from the PENDING row so it renders before ingest finishes.

title: Measure ingest phases then tune the new env flags
description: Per-phase timings now log as an emoji-prefixed line per document (parse=..ms blurbs=..ms embed=..ms total=..ms). Run one ~30-page opinion and one ~100-page brief through the pipeline and record the split before tuning. New env vars, all with safe defaults: BLURB_BATCH_SIZE (now 20, was 8), BLURB_CONTEXT_CHARS (2000), BLURB_CONCURRENCY (16), INGEST_LLM_THREADS (24), INGEST_PARSE_THREADS (cpu count), INGEST_CACHE_DIR, DOCLING_TABLE_STRUCTURE (true), DOCLING_NUM_THREADS (cpu count), SPECULATIVE_UPLOAD_BARRIER_TIMEOUT_S (90). DOCLING_TABLE_STRUCTURE=false is the biggest untested win for table-free court opinions - verify retrieval quality on a document with tables before flipping the default. Also confirm the worker has writable disk at INGEST_CACHE_DIR.
